text:
marina: Heads-up from the postmortem — we've got a recurring 'inference-cache thrash' pattern across a few incidents. Proposing runbook changes: add signal detection (eviction rate + burst latency), quick triage commands, and a clear on-call handoff with escalation to dedicated infra. Owners needed for edits and automation. Summary + next steps below.

raj: I can do detection signals + alert rule. Will add Grafana panels + short query. ETA Wed 03/25. I'll link INF-4321 when created. @liz @tom any preferences for alert thresholds?

liz: I'll update the triage checklist and paste the commands for quick collection. Will include small `kubectl` snippets and a one-liner to collect recent KV-cache stats. ETA Fri 03/27.

tom: I'll create a backlog ticket for auto-fallback to lower-latency model variant and a canary rollout step. Also propose a short automation to move noisy tenants into a degraded pool. ETA Mon 03/30.

eva_kim: Please include the exact escalation path text. Proposal: if eviction_rate > 5% for 5m -> page oncall; if 95th latency > 1.2s for 5m -> page infra-sre and trigger fallback. Add a soft-fallback policy and who must approve it.

oncall-jordan: One ask — add an immediate 'isolate noisy tenant' checklist with commands I can run in ~5m. Example: how to pin a tenant to a lower-QPS queue and how to temporarily throttle. Also need the minimal logs set to attach to the page.

liz: snippet for the runbook (paste into the triage section):
```bash
# check eviction count and top pods by mem
kubectl exec -n prod svc/cache-mgr -- redis-cli INFO | grep evicted_keys
kubectl top pods -n prod --containers | sort -k3 -h | tail -n 10
# collect last 5m of inference logs (json lines)
kubectl logs -n prod -l app=inference --since=5m --tail=500 > /tmp/inference-5m.json
```
Add also `curl` to sample the health endpoint for KV hit/miss rates.

marina: Good. Also add an exact handoff template to the runbook: who you're paging, preferred contact channel, required artifacts (logs, grafana snapshot, recent deploy hash), and a short summary sentence. I'll draft the template.

ops-bot: Reminder: when editing incidents, add the `recurring=cache-thrash` tag if a pattern is detected. This makes it queryable by the monthly review.

raj: Assigned -> detection rules + grafana (owner: raj). Ticket: INF-4321 (will link PR).

tom: Assigned -> fallback automation + canary rollout (owner: tom). Ticket: INF-4330.

liz: Assigned -> runbook edit + commands section + handoff template (owner: liz). Ticket: DOC-289.

marina: I'll own the escalation matrix edit and the handoff template. Can we sync Tue 10:00am PT for a quick review? :calendar: @oncall-jordan does that work for the on-call demo?

oncall-jordan: 10:00am PT works. I'll bring example logs & the last incident's timeline.

eva_kim: Adding one more item — add a recurring-incident review cadence (monthly) and an automated query that lists incident clusters by tag. I'll draft a short RFC and drop it in #eng-sre.

marina: Thanks team — I'll update this thread with PR links and final due dates. :thumbsup:
